decision.reason: SEMI confirmed at Semicon West 2026 that silicon/organic bridges are a production response to limitations of large interposers; engineers plausibly need versioned process trial, measurement and yield evidence. Competition belongs to Validation.
decision.article_title: SEMI Says Bridge Technology Will Lead Next-Gen Large-Format Packaging - THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media

opportunities.core_job: Record bridge material, process and package trial tolerance/yield evidence against competing interposer designs
opportunities.target_customer: Advanced semiconductor package design and process engineering teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Design/bridge type → material & alignment measurement CSV → thermal/cycle test results → yield deviation → engineer signoff
opportunities.why_now: SEMI 12 Oct 2026 briefing predicts bridge packaging to replace larger interposers for advanced heterogeneous chiplet packaging
opportunities.before_state: Package bridge process tests, physical defect/yield metrics and test evidence are in supplier emails and unlinked lab reports
opportunities.after_state: Trace each experimental process recipe and package design to measurement, tolerance, failures and go/no-go decision

source_observations.observation: SEMI's Beth Keser discusses silicon/organic bridge transition at Semicon West; direct publication confirms technical constraints of large interposers.
